prompted_for: A service visit as a route around the system (Grid as: "route", VisitRoute)
composition: portrait sheet inset in a thin navy border
large uppercase title top-left, small logo top-right
8 numbered stations scattered across the sheet in a loose 3-row grid
one meandering dashed path snakes between every station from top to bottom
inlet and outlet arrows mark the route ends
layout_devices: dashed meandering route line linking stations
boxed two-digit step numbers before each label
corner crop marks and registration crosshairs
bracketed highlight frame around one station
palette: navy ink line work and type
muted steel-blue fills on vessels and membranes
typography: large mono title in two lines
tiny mono caps captions under icons
ui_patterns: station cards with icon plus label
motion_implied: dash travels along the route from inlet to sign-off
stations light up in steel-blue as the route reaches them
checkmark draws on the sign-off clipboard
t2i_keywords: warm cream paper sheet on deep navy mat
meandering dashed route line connecting stations
numbered stations in boxed mono numerals
thin sheet border with ruler ticks
highlight bracket frame on one item
t2i_prompt: Technical blueprint poster on a warm cream paper sheet framed by a deep navy border. A meandering dashed route line snakes from an inlet arrow at the top through numbered stations to a final sign-off at the bottom. Each station is a small schematic line icon in uniform 1.5 px navy strokes with spot steel-blue fills, labelled with a boxed two-digit mono numeral and short uppercase monospaced caption: <CONTENT>. Large uppercase monospaced headline top-left, corner crop marks, registration crosshairs, ruler ticks on margins, tiny engineering title block. Flat vector, no shading, generous negative space, calm and precise.
signature_idea: A maintenance visit drawn as a dashed walking route that visits each numbered piece of equipment on a drafting sheet.
strengths: makes an abstract service scope tangible and sequential
equipment icons are recognisable to engineers
palette and line weight close to the brand
route device is reusable for any ordered process
weaknesses: duplicated stations (pretreatment and RO appear twice) and numbering breaks
route loops are decorative rather than following real flow
all-mono uppercase type is off-brand and tiring
dense lower half loses the space-as-material calm
brand_fit_why: Navy/limestone with one steel-blue accent and square precise line art fits well; all-caps mono headings instead of Geist light headlines and some clutter cost a point.
